messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: Set fill = ~variable with layer_boxplots?
parts:
Hi,

I would like to do something like this:

mtcars %>% ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(cyl), y = mpg, fill=as.factor(vs))) + 
  geom_boxplot() 

with ggvis. I tried this:

mtcars %>% ggvis(~cyl, ~mpg, fill = ~as.factor(vs)) %>% layer_boxplots(width = 0.5)

and it gives me this error:

Error in is.factor(x) : object 'vs' not found

What am I doing wrong?

Thanks!

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Set fill = ~variable with layer_boxplots?
parts:
You probably need to group_by(vs) in order to get one boxplot per vs.
Hadley
